# Generated scalar D.E.C. completed-return replay; no native random sampling.
# Coarse facet motion and Q4 return realizations are separately declared maps.
# Generator source SHA-256: 32d253536cffef0f023afa67bd4ec97b75c6d3047b3b53f1a59bc0777f5377d0
# Host model evaluator source SHA-256: a1e307047d2dfd1bfe248a57d7b54169ac5f910cb41671540177dfaa5681fe62
# Configuration SHA-256: 92bef637d13b5ce51f49edc6cb26d47af618c6a06defc5fdec34771170bbc0a1

# Scalar output: q_a, q_b, chi_a, chi_b, phases_a, phases_b, beats_a, beats_b; then A trace, B trace, result.
Dec population_count(facet) -> count:
    (str facet) -> int count:
        assert facet == "0***" or facet == "1***" or facet == "*0**" or facet == "*1**" or facet == "**0*" or facet == "**1*" or facet == "***0" or facet == "***1"
        count = 1 if facet == "0***" else (1 if facet == "1***" else (4 if facet == "*0**" else (1 if facet == "*1**" else (1 if facet == "**0*" else (1 if facet == "**1*" else (1 if facet == "***0" else (1)))))))

Dec q_local(facet) -> q:
    (str facet) -> ratio q:
        ratio score = ratio(population_count(facet) - 1, 3)
        q = ratio(1, 16) + (ratio(1, 4) - ratio(1, 16)) * score

Dec q_contact(base, present) -> q:
    (ratio base, bool present) -> ratio q:
        q = base + ratio(1, 4) * (ratio(1, 1) - base) if present else base

Dec recur_plus(t) -> out:
    (trace t) -> trace out:
        t = step(t, q4(1), t1(1))
        t = hinge(t)
        t = step(t, q4(0), t1(-1))
        out = close(t)

Dec recur_minus(t) -> out:
    (trace t) -> trace out:
        t = step(t, q4(1), t1(-1))
        t = hinge(t)
        t = step(t, q4(0), t1(1))
        out = close(t)

Dec main() -> result:
    () -> int result:
        int chi_a = 1
        int chi_b = -1
        str facet_a = "0***"
        str facet_b = "1***"
        trace a = trace("chiral-encounter:declared-support", "carrier-A", q4(0))
        trace b = trace("chiral-encounter:declared-support", "carrier-B", q4(0))
        a = recur_plus(a) if chi_a == 1 else recur_minus(a)
        a = recur_plus(a) if chi_a == 1 else recur_minus(a)
        assert phases(a) == 2
        assert beats(a) == 1
        b = recur_plus(b) if chi_b == 1 else recur_minus(b)
        b = recur_plus(b) if chi_b == 1 else recur_minus(b)
        assert phases(b) == 2
        assert beats(b) == 1
        ratio q_a = ratio(0, 1)
        ratio q_b = ratio(0, 1)
        bool present = false
        bool flip_a = false
        bool flip_b = false
        # Tick 1: declared post-move facets; movement tickets (2, 0) / 8.
        facet_a = "*0**"
        facet_b = "1***"
        present = facet_a == facet_b
        q_a = q_contact(q_local(facet_a), present)
        q_b = q_contact(q_local(facet_b), present)
        flip_a = ratio(21, 64) < q_a
        flip_b = ratio(28, 64) < q_b
        chi_a = -chi_a if flip_a else chi_a
        chi_b = -chi_b if flip_b else chi_b
        a = recur_plus(a) if chi_a == 1 else recur_minus(a)
        b = recur_plus(b) if chi_b == 1 else recur_minus(b)
        assert phases(a) == 3
        assert phases(b) == 3
        assert beats(a) == 2
        assert beats(b) == 2
        emit q_a
        emit q_b
        emit chi_a
        emit chi_b
        emit phases(a)
        emit phases(b)
        emit beats(a)
        emit beats(b)
        # Tick 2: declared post-move facets; movement tickets (1, 7) / 8.
        facet_a = "1***"
        facet_b = "***1"
        present = facet_a == facet_b
        q_a = q_contact(q_local(facet_a), present)
        q_b = q_contact(q_local(facet_b), present)
        flip_a = ratio(37, 64) < q_a
        flip_b = ratio(46, 64) < q_b
        chi_a = -chi_a if flip_a else chi_a
        chi_b = -chi_b if flip_b else chi_b
        a = recur_plus(a) if chi_a == 1 else recur_minus(a)
        b = recur_plus(b) if chi_b == 1 else recur_minus(b)
